rules.rule: Search state, cache key, late-response acceptance, selection, and scroll anchors bind serverId + userId.
itemType is part of stable identity; a Movie, Audio, and Book may share the same title and must coexist.
Repeated rows with the same stable identity and namespace fold once; source capabilities may be overlaid.
Same title and same itemType with different itemId remain distinct.
A downloaded copy with proven serverId + userId + itemType + itemId overlays the matching server identity.
Download provenance that is absent or unverified remains an isolated legacy row and never folds by title.
Local media identity uses libraryId + localStableId + itemType; equal titles do not prove equivalence.
Server and local rows fold only with explicit shared stable identity evidence; otherwise both remain visible.
Pagination de-duplicates by stable identity across pages of the same generation and query shape.
Scroll and selection anchors use stableIdentity, not list index, title, or card position.
Every item must match its active scope before identity folding; invalid items cannot be rescued by an existing identity.

ordering.withinScopeServerPrimary: server response order produced by sortBy=SortName, sortOrder=Ascending
ordering.stabilityInvariant: The same stable identities and sort fields produce the same order regardless of callback completion order; download/local overlays do not move rows.

selectionAndScroll.missingAnchorOnRestore: clamp scroll and clear selection with observable reason

currentImplementationObservation.observedShape: SearchState keeps one result list and category filters; SearchViewModel stores query and scope in SavedStateHandle.
